goal: Prevent node crashes and shutdown hangs when background chainstate compaction runs on low disk space
Defer compaction if available disk space is insufficient for temporary database duplication
Show compaction start and finish messages in standard logs instead of hiding them behind debug flags
agreement: Unaddressed objection: do not warn on low disk space because users cannot act on it (andrewtoth)
Questioned whether this change warrants a release note (andrewtoth)
Supported after iterations on disk space checks and skipping in-memory compaction (stickies-v, optout21)

categories.name: validation
why: P1 because it prevents node crashes and shutdown hangs when background compaction fills the disk
Resolves a critical reliability regression for nodes running with tight storage margins
